_comment: Calibrated 2026-09-24. Lags/thresholds from analyze_correlation.py; hold_days from event_study.py's day-by-day decay curves (see lag_correlation_results.csv and the event_study.py printout). gold->TITAN.NS and gold->MANAPPURAM.NS were tested and dropped: no lagged edge. NOTE: gold->MUTHOOTFIN.NS and copper->HINDCOPPER.NS decay/reverse in the second (more recent) half of history — hold_days set conservatively short for those, before the reversal starts. silver->VEDL.NS is the most durable signal found: it keeps growing through day 7 in both halves.

_position_sizing._explanation: position_value = paper_capital_inr * base_bet_pct_of_capital/100 * min(move_strength, max_size_multiplier), where move_strength = |commodity_pct_change| / threshold_pct (so a move that's 2x the trigger threshold gets ~2x the bet, capped at max_size_multiplier). New trades are skipped once max_concurrent_positions are open.

MUTHOOTFIN.NS.note: peak at h5 but half2 turns negative by h6 - exit early

HINDZINC.NS.note: peak at h3, half2 decays after h6

VEDL.NS.note: most durable pair found - keeps growing to h7+ in both halves

HINDALCO.NS.note: fast peak at h2, stable both halves, mild erosion after h7

HINDCOPPER.NS.note: reverses hard after h7 in both halves - exit early

VEDL.NS.note: weakest of the six, decays after h7
